name: revised-down
about: §4R L2: Meta revised yesterday's numbers down overnight; the fold holds only the revised figures, which are smaller than the first report.

output.headline: On November 2, 2026, Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign running, delivering 2 leads from $110.90 in spend at a $55.45 cost per lead.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet produced 70 clicks from 6,015 impressions at a 1.2% click rate, with 2 leads at $55.45 each.
Month-to-date spend in November 2026 is $198.00 on Meta, with 29 days left in the month.

The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) has 17 converted, 10 applied, 4 hired, and 8 lost after conversion. The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) has 20 converted, 12 applied, 5 hired, and 9 lost after conversion.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion — but it is too young to judge.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded.
